evidence.quote: On the Moon there is no air, so a thrown ball feels no drag at all. Its flight is purely ballistic.
the ball moves x = U0 * t across the ground.
The vertical speed is V = V0 - g * t, and the height is y = V0 * t - g * t^2 / 2.
Putting that time into the height equation gives the highest point: ymax = V0^2 / (2 * g).

objectives: Calculate the maximum height of a projectile using ymax = V0^2 / (2 * g) from initial vertical speed V0 and gravity g
Describe drag-free ballistic flight as uniform horizontal motion x = U0 * t and vertical motion y = V0 * t - g * t^2 / 2 with vertical speed V = V0 - g * t
